%pyspark
# ---------- 3. Definitions: the SQL (do not edit) and the helper functions ----------------
import calendar, datetime, time

ITEMS_SQL = """WITH -- What: item rows in the window, cleaned (rules R1 to R13), each item numbered once.
-- Why:  the view repeats some items many times, so duplicates must go before any count.
raw AS (
  -- only the 24 columns the model uses, so Spark moves far less data in every step
  SELECT v.instance_id, v.key_itm_nbr, v.assessment_dt_wid, v.taxpayer_tin,
         v.regime_cd, v.decl_status, v.cpc_cd, v.extended_proc_cd,
         v.hsc_cd, v.gds_org_cty, v.customs_value, v.net_weight,
         v.supplementary_qnty, v.tax_assessed, v.original_tax_amt, v.final_amt,
         v.top_up_flg, v.amendment_flg, v.clearance_station_cd, v.is_red_flg,
         v.is_yellow_flg, v.pay_status, v.consignee_tin, v.preferential_treatment_flag,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.instance_id, v.key_itm_nbr ORDER BY v.assessment_dt_wid) AS rn
  FROM dm_modeled_ura_datascience.vw_cstm_AEO_model v
  WHERE v.assessment_dt_wid >  '@@HIST3_START@@'
    AND v.assessment_dt_wid <= '@@OUT_END@@'
    AND v.regime_cd IN ('IM4', 'IM7')
    AND v.decl_status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND v.taxpayer_tin RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$'
),

-- What: one row per declaration item (duplicates dropped).
items AS (
  SELECT r.*, to_date(r.assessment_dt_wid, 'yyyyMMdd') AS adate
  FROM raw r
  WHERE r.rn = 1
)

SELECT * FROM items
"""
MAIN_SQL = """WITH p AS (
  SELECT DATE '@@SNAP_DATE@@' AS snap
),

items AS (SELECT * FROM ctrp_items),

-- What: items in the 24-month history only (features are built from history, never the future).
hist_items AS (
  SELECT * FROM items WHERE assessment_dt_wid > '@@HIST_START@@' AND assessment_dt_wid <= '@@SNAP@@'
),

-- ---------- one row per declaration ---------------------------------------------------
-- What: one row per declaration with its tax, top-up and lane.
-- Why:  tax amounts repeat on every item row, so they are taken once per declaration.
decl_all AS (
  SELECT instance_id,
         MAX(taxpayer_tin)                                   AS tin,
         MAX(adate)                                          AS adate,
         MAX(assessment_dt_wid)                              AS dt,
         MAX(regime_cd)                                      AS regime,
         COALESCE(MAX(original_tax_amt), MAX(final_amt))     AS orig_tax,
         MAX(final_amt)                                      AS final_tax,
         MAX(top_up_flg)                                     AS top_up_flg,
         MAX(amendment_flg)                                  AS amended,
         MAX(clearance_station_cd)                           AS station,
         MAX(is_red_flg)                                     AS red,
         MAX(is_yellow_flg)                                  AS yellow,
         MAX(pay_status)                                     AS pay_status,
         MAX(TRIM(consignee_tin))                            AS cons_tin,
         SUM(customs_value)                                  AS value,
         COUNT(*)                                            AS n_items
  FROM items
  GROUP BY instance_id
),

decl AS (
  SELECT d.*,
         CASE WHEN d.top_up_flg = 'Y' AND d.final_tax > d.orig_tax THEN 1 ELSE 0 END             AS topped_up,
         CASE WHEN d.top_up_flg = 'Y' AND d.final_tax > d.orig_tax
              THEN d.final_tax - d.orig_tax ELSE 0 END                                          AS top_up,
         CASE WHEN d.final_tax < d.orig_tax THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                                   AS negative_top_up
  FROM decl_all d
),

hist AS (SELECT * FROM decl WHERE dt > '@@HIST_START@@' AND dt <= '@@SNAP@@'),

fut  AS (SELECT * FROM decl WHERE dt >  '@@SNAP@@'),

-- ---------- scored parameters and pattern features from declarations ------------------
-- What: one row per taxpayer with every rate the scorecard uses.
tp AS (
  SELECT h.tin,
         COUNT(*)                                                         AS entries_24m,
         COUNT(DISTINCT date_format(h.adate, 'yyyyMM'))                   AS active_months,
         AVG(h.n_items)                                                   AS avg_items_per_entry,
         SUM(h.value)                                                     AS total_customs_value,
         SUM(h.orig_tax)                                                  AS total_original_tax,
         SUM(h.top_up)                                                    AS total_top_up,

         AVG(CASE WHEN h.amended = 'Y' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)             AS par045_amended_entry_rate,
         SUM(h.top_up) / NULLIF(SUM(h.orig_tax), 0)                       AS par048_top_up_ratio,
         AVG(CAST(h.negative_top_up AS DOUBLE))                           AS par066_negative_top_up_rate,
         AVG(CASE WHEN h.topped_up = 1 AND h.top_up >= 0.30 * h.final_tax
                  THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)                                  AS par077_severe_top_up_rate,
         DATEDIFF(MAX(p.snap), MAX(CASE WHEN h.topped_up = 1 THEN h.adate END))
                                                                          AS par105_days_since_last_top_up,
         AVG(CAST(h.topped_up AS DOUBLE))                                 AS top_up_entry_rate,
         DATEDIFF(MAX(p.snap), MIN(h.adate))                              AS days_since_first_in_window,

         COUNT(DISTINCT h.station)                                        AS stations_used_24m,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.adate > date_sub(p.snap, 90) THEN h.station END)
                                                                          AS stations_used_90d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.adate > date_sub(p.snap, 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)  AS entries_last_90d,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.adate >  date_sub(p.snap, 180)
                   AND h.adate <= date_sub(p.snap, 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entries_prev_90d,
         AVG(CASE WHEN h.regime = 'IM7' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)            AS im7_share,
         COUNT(DISTINCT h.cons_tin)                                       AS distinct_consignees,
         AVG(CASE WHEN h.cons_tin = h.tin THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)          AS consignee_is_self_share,

         AVG(CASE WHEN h.pay_status = 'NOT_PAID' AND h.final_tax > 0
                  THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)                                  AS ctx_unpaid_rate,
         AVG(CASE WHEN h.red = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)                   AS ctx_red_lane_rate,
         AVG(CASE WHEN h.yellow = 1 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)                AS ctx_yellow_lane_rate
  FROM hist h
  CROSS JOIN p
  GROUP BY h.tin
),

-- ---------- the same counts per year, over 3 years (for recency weighting) ---------------
-- What: for each of the 3 years before the snapshot (y1 = most recent 12 months, y2 = the 12
--       before, y3 = the 12 before that): declarations, and how many were topped up, severely
--       topped up, amended or had tax reduced, with the top-up and original tax amounts.
-- Why:  a recency-weighted rate is (w1 x count1 + w2 x count2 + w3 x count3) / (the same for
--       declarations), so these counts let any weights be tried in Python without another pull.
--       Check: y1 + y2 declarations always equal entries_24m.
yr AS (
  SELECT h.tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                         AS y1_entries,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 1 THEN h.topped_up ELSE 0 END)               AS y1_topped_up,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 1 THEN h.severe ELSE 0 END)                  AS y1_severe,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 1 AND h.amended = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS y1_amended,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 1 THEN h.negative_top_up ELSE 0 END)         AS y1_tax_reduced,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 1 THEN h.top_up ELSE 0 END)                  AS y1_top_up_ugx,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 1 THEN h.orig_tax ELSE 0 END)                AS y1_original_tax_ugx,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                         AS y2_entries,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 2 THEN h.topped_up ELSE 0 END)               AS y2_topped_up,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 2 THEN h.severe ELSE 0 END)                  AS y2_severe,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 2 AND h.amended = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS y2_amended,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 2 THEN h.negative_top_up ELSE 0 END)         AS y2_tax_reduced,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 2 THEN h.top_up ELSE 0 END)                  AS y2_top_up_ugx,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 2 THEN h.orig_tax ELSE 0 END)                AS y2_original_tax_ugx,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                         AS y3_entries,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 3 THEN h.topped_up ELSE 0 END)               AS y3_topped_up,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 3 THEN h.severe ELSE 0 END)                  AS y3_severe,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 3 AND h.amended = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)     AS y3_amended,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 3 THEN h.negative_top_up ELSE 0 END)         AS y3_tax_reduced,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 3 THEN h.top_up ELSE 0 END)                  AS y3_top_up_ugx,
         SUM(CASE WHEN h.yb = 3 THEN h.orig_tax ELSE 0 END)                AS y3_original_tax_ugx,
         DATEDIFF(MAX(h.snap), MAX(CASE WHEN h.topped_up = 1 THEN h.adate END)) AS days_since_last_top_up_36m
  FROM (
    SELECT d.*, p.snap,
           CASE WHEN d.adate > add_months(p.snap, -12) THEN 1
                WHEN d.adate > add_months(p.snap, -24) THEN 2 ELSE 3 END   AS yb,
           CASE WHEN d.topped_up = 1 AND d.top_up >= 0.30 * d.final_tax THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS severe
    FROM decl d
    CROSS JOIN p
    WHERE d.dt <= '@@SNAP@@'
  ) h
  GROUP BY h.tin
),

st AS (
  SELECT tin, MAX(n) / SUM(n) AS main_station_share
  FROM (SELECT tin, station, COUNT(*) AS n FROM hist GROUP BY tin, station) x
  GROUP BY tin
),

-- ---------- structure, for peer segmentation -------------------------------------------
-- What: how each taxpayer trades (goods, origins, CPCs, stations, items per declaration).
-- Why:  used to put taxpayers in peer groups and in the pattern check.
struct AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin                                                     AS tin,
         COUNT(DISTINCT substr(hsc_cd, 1, 4))                             AS hs_headings_used,
         COUNT(DISTINCT gds_org_cty)                                      AS origins_used,
         COUNT(DISTINCT cpc_cd)                                           AS cpcs_used,
         AVG(CASE WHEN preferential_treatment_flag = 'Y' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END)
                                                                          AS ctx_preferential_use_rate
  FROM hist_items
  GROUP BY taxpayer_tin
),

-- What: each taxpayer's main HS chapter (most customs value) and its share of their value.
dom AS (
  SELECT tin, hs_chapter AS dominant_hs_chapter, chapter_value_share
  FROM (
    SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin,
           substr(hsc_cd, 1, 2) AS hs_chapter,
           SUM(customs_value) / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(customs_value)) OVER (PARTITION BY taxpayer_tin), 0)
                                AS chapter_value_share,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY taxpayer_tin ORDER BY SUM(customs_value) DESC) AS rn
    FROM hist_items
    GROUP BY taxpayer_tin, substr(hsc_cd, 1, 2)
  ) z
  WHERE rn = 1
),

-- ---------- PAR_076 with the interim benchmark -----------------------------------------
-- Benchmark = median unit value for the HS code across all importers (5 or more).
-- Low = below half the median on BOTH bases (per kg alone where no supplementary quantity).
-- Items below 1% of the median are treated as entry errors (a weight or quantity in the
-- wrong unit), counted separately and kept out of the shortfall, so that one keying error
-- cannot make a taxpayer look like the worst undervaluer in the country.
bench AS (
  SELECT hsc_cd,
         percentile_approx(customs_value / net_weight, 0.5)                         AS med_per_kg,
         percentile_approx(CASE WHEN supplementary_qnty > 0
                                THEN customs_value / supplementary_qnty END, 0.5)    AS med_per_unit
  FROM hist_items
  WHERE customs_value > 0 AND net_weight > 0
  GROUP BY hsc_cd
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT taxpayer_tin) >= 5
),

-- (5) Benchmark per HS code AND origin where 5+ importers bring that code from that origin,
-- otherwise the HS-wide benchmark above. Goods of one code differ in price by origin.
bench_o AS (
  SELECT hsc_cd, gds_org_cty,
         percentile_approx(customs_value / net_weight, 0.5)                         AS med_per_kg,
         percentile_approx(CASE WHEN supplementary_qnty > 0
                                THEN customs_value / supplementary_qnty END, 0.5)    AS med_per_unit
  FROM hist_items
  WHERE customs_value > 0 AND net_weight > 0
  GROUP BY hsc_cd, gds_org_cty
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT taxpayer_tin) >= 5
),

items_b AS (
  SELECT i.*,
         COALESCE(o.med_per_kg, b.med_per_kg)                             AS bm_kg,
         CASE WHEN o.med_per_kg IS NOT NULL THEN o.med_per_unit ELSE b.med_per_unit END AS bm_unit,
         CASE WHEN o.med_per_kg IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END             AS on_origin_bench
  FROM hist_items i
  JOIN bench b ON i.hsc_cd = b.hsc_cd
  LEFT JOIN bench_o o ON i.hsc_cd = o.hsc_cd AND i.gds_org_cty = o.gds_org_cty
  WHERE i.customs_value > 0 AND i.net_weight > 0
),

val AS (
  SELECT i.taxpayer_tin AS tin,
         i.customs_value,
         i.on_origin_bench,
         -- (6) how far the price per kg sits from peers, either way (log scale)
         ABS(LN((i.customs_value / i.net_weight) / i.bm_kg))              AS price_deviation,
         CASE WHEN i.customs_value / i.net_weight < 0.01 * i.bm_kg THEN 1 ELSE 0 END    AS implausible,
         CASE WHEN i.customs_value / i.net_weight <  0.5 * i.bm_kg
               AND i.customs_value / i.net_weight >= 0.01 * i.bm_kg
               AND (i.bm_unit IS NULL OR i.supplementary_qnty IS NULL OR i.supplementary_qnty <= 0
                    OR i.customs_value / i.supplementary_qnty < 0.5 * i.bm_unit)
              THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                                           AS low_price,
         LEAST(i.bm_kg * i.net_weight - i.customs_value,
               CASE WHEN i.supplementary_qnty > 0 AND i.bm_unit IS NOT NULL
                    THEN i.bm_unit * i.supplementary_qnty - i.customs_value END)
                                                                          AS shortfall
  FROM items_b i
),

v76 AS (
  SELECT tin,
         COUNT(*)                                                         AS items_benchmarked,
         AVG(CAST(implausible AS DOUBLE))                                 AS ctx_implausible_price_rate,
         AVG(CAST(low_price AS DOUBLE))                                   AS par076_low_price_item_rate,
         SUM(CASE WHEN low_price = 1 AND shortfall > 0 THEN shortfall ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(customs_value), 0)                                AS par076_shortfall_share,
         AVG(CAST(on_origin_bench AS DOUBLE))                             AS origin_benchmark_share,
         percentile_approx(CASE WHEN implausible = 0 THEN price_deviation END, 0.5)
                                                                          AS price_deviation_median
  FROM val
  GROUP BY tin
),

-- ---------- (1) price against the taxpayer's own history (PAR_067 stand-in) -------------
-- For each HS code the taxpayer imported both in the last 6 months and in the 18 months
-- before: did the median price fall below 70% of their own earlier price, on both bases
-- (per kg, and per unit where recorded)? Measured as a share of recent value.
own AS (
  SELECT i.taxpayer_tin AS tin, i.hsc_cd,
         percentile_approx(CASE WHEN i.adate <= add_months(p.snap, -6) THEN i.customs_value / i.net_weight END, 0.5) AS early_kg,
         percentile_approx(CASE WHEN i.adate >  add_months(p.snap, -6) THEN i.customs_value / i.net_weight END, 0.5) AS late_kg,
         percentile_approx(CASE WHEN i.adate <= add_months(p.snap, -6) AND i.supplementary_qnty > 0
                                THEN i.customs_value / i.supplementary_qnty END, 0.5)                          AS early_u,
         percentile_approx(CASE WHEN i.adate >  add_months(p.snap, -6) AND i.supplementary_qnty > 0
                                THEN i.customs_value / i.supplementary_qnty END, 0.5)                          AS late_u,
         SUM(CASE WHEN i.adate > add_months(p.snap, -6) THEN i.customs_value ELSE 0 END)                       AS late_value,
         SUM(CASE WHEN i.adate <= add_months(p.snap, -6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                    AS n_early,
         SUM(CASE WHEN i.adate >  add_months(p.snap, -6) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                    AS n_late
  FROM hist_items i
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE i.customs_value > 0 AND i.net_weight > 0
  GROUP BY i.taxpayer_tin, i.hsc_cd
),

own_tp AS (
  SELECT tin,
         COUNT(*)                                                         AS hs_codes_compared,
         SUM(CASE WHEN late_kg < 0.7 * early_kg
                   AND (early_u IS NULL OR late_u IS NULL OR late_u < 0.7 * early_u)
                  THEN late_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(late_value), 0) AS own_price_drop_share
  FROM own
  WHERE n_early >= 2 AND n_late >= 1 AND early_kg > 0
  GROUP BY tin
),

-- ---------- (2) duty rate against HS peers, and exemption use -------------------------------
-- The CPC on a declaration = EPC (extended_proc_cd, 4 digits) + APC (cpc_cd, 3 digits), per the
-- AC-Trade memo CUS/T/9.5.5 of 19 Nov 2025. An APC other than 000 claims a rebate or
-- exemption, so a lower rate under such an APC is expected and is NOT counted as low duty.
-- (2a) Low duty: items under APC 000 (no exemption claimed) taxed at under half the median
--      rate other importers pay on the same HS code, also under APC 000.
-- (2b) Exemption use: share of value declared under any exemption APC.
-- (2c) Watch-list APCs: share of value under the APCs the memo marks "look out for possible
--      abuse" (404, 409, 417, 451, 455, 457, 476, 479, 481, 482, 484). Several of these are
--      marked "not in use", so any use at all is worth an officer's attention.
duty_bench AS (
  SELECT hsc_cd, percentile_approx(tax_assessed / customs_value, 0.5)   AS med_rate
  FROM hist_items
  WHERE customs_value > 0 AND tax_assessed >= 0 AND cpc_cd = '000'
  GROUP BY hsc_cd
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT taxpayer_tin) >= 5
),

duty_tp AS (
  SELECT i.taxpayer_tin AS tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN i.cpc_cd = '000' AND b.med_rate > 0 AND i.tax_assessed / i.customs_value < 0.5 * b.med_rate
                  THEN i.customs_value ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN i.cpc_cd = '000' AND b.med_rate > 0 THEN i.customs_value ELSE 0 END), 0)
                                                                          AS low_duty_value_share,
         SUM(CASE WHEN i.cpc_cd = '000' AND b.med_rate > 0
                  THEN GREATEST(b.med_rate * i.customs_value - i.tax_assessed, 0) ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN i.cpc_cd = '000' AND b.med_rate > 0 THEN i.customs_value ELSE 0 END), 0)
                                                                          AS duty_gap_share
  FROM hist_items i
  LEFT JOIN duty_bench b ON i.hsc_cd = b.hsc_cd
  WHERE i.customs_value > 0 AND i.tax_assessed >= 0
  GROUP BY i.taxpayer_tin
),

apc_tp AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN cpc_cd <> '000' THEN customs_value ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(customs_value), 0)                                AS exemption_apc_value_share,
         SUM(CASE WHEN cpc_cd IN ('404','409','417','451','455','457','476','479','481','482','484')
                  THEN customs_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(customs_value), 0)
                                                                          AS watchlist_apc_value_share,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cpc_cd IN ('404','409','417','451','455','457','476','479','481','482','484')
                             THEN cpc_cd END)                             AS watchlist_apcs_used
  FROM hist_items
  WHERE customs_value > 0
  GROUP BY taxpayer_tin
),

-- ---------- (3) splitting: same HS code, same day, separate declarations ------------------
-- Bulk goods (cement, fuel, steel) legitimately arrive as many trucks a day, one declaration
-- each. Two protections:
--   * fixed exclusions: HS chapters 25 (cement, clinker, salt) and 27 (fuel), and fuel
--     transit EPCs 4080 and 7180. Edit the lists below to add more.
--   * peer norm: for every other HS code, how often ALL importers lodge same-day repeats.
--     A taxpayer is measured by how far they exceed the norm for their own mix of goods,
--     so a code where repeats are normal protects itself.
split_grp AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin, assessment_dt_wid, hsc_cd, COUNT(DISTINCT instance_id) AS n
  FROM hist_items
  WHERE substr(hsc_cd, 1, 2) NOT IN ('25', '27')
    AND COALESCE(extended_proc_cd, '') NOT IN ('4080', '7180')
  GROUP BY taxpayer_tin, assessment_dt_wid, hsc_cd
),

split_norm AS (
  SELECT hsc_cd, SUM(CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN n ELSE 0 END) / SUM(n)     AS norm_share
  FROM split_grp
  GROUP BY hsc_cd
),

split_tp AS (
  SELECT g.tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN g.n >= 2 THEN g.n ELSE 0 END) / SUM(g.n)         AS same_day_split_share,
         SUM(g.n * m.norm_share) / SUM(g.n)                              AS same_day_split_expected,
         SUM(CASE WHEN g.n >= 2 THEN g.n ELSE 0 END) / SUM(g.n)
           - SUM(g.n * m.norm_share) / SUM(g.n)                          AS same_day_split_excess,
         MAX(g.n)                                                        AS max_same_day_same_hs
  FROM split_grp g
  JOIN split_norm m ON g.hsc_cd = m.hsc_cd
  GROUP BY g.tin
),

-- ---------- (4) new traders: no IM4/IM7 declaration in the 3 years before the window -------
prior AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT taxpayer_tin AS tin
  FROM dm_modeled_ura_datascience.vw_cstm_AEO_model
  WHERE assessment_dt_wid >  '@@PRIOR_START@@'
    AND assessment_dt_wid <= '@@HIST_START@@'
    AND regime_cd IN ('IM4', 'IM7')
    AND decl_status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND taxpayer_tin RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$'
),

-- ---------- outcomes in the 6 months after the snapshot --------------------------------
-- What: what happened next: declarations checked (red or yellow) and how many ended in a top-up.
-- Why:  the back-test judges the score against these, so they come only from AFTER the snapshot.
outc AS (
  SELECT tin,
         COUNT(*)                                                         AS out_entries,
         SUM(CASE WHEN red = 1 OR yellow = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)           AS out_checked,
         SUM(CASE WHEN (red = 1 OR yellow = 1) AND topped_up = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
                                                                          AS out_checked_hits,
         SUM(topped_up)                                                   AS out_topped_up_entries,
         SUM(top_up)                                                      AS out_top_up,
         SUM(orig_tax)                                                    AS out_original_tax
  FROM fut
  GROUP BY tin
)

-- ---------- final row per taxpayer ---
SELECT tp.tin                                                  AS taxpayer_tin,
       '@@SNAP_DATE@@'                                         AS snapshot_date,
       CASE WHEN tp.entries_24m < 10 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END     AS limited_history,
       tp.entries_24m, tp.active_months, tp.avg_items_per_entry,
       tp.total_customs_value, tp.total_original_tax, tp.total_top_up,
       s.hs_headings_used, s.origins_used, s.cpcs_used,
       dm.dominant_hs_chapter, dm.chapter_value_share,
       tp.stations_used_24m, tp.stations_used_90d, st.main_station_share,
       tp.entries_last_90d, tp.entries_prev_90d, tp.im7_share,
       tp.distinct_consignees, tp.consignee_is_self_share,
       tp.par045_amended_entry_rate,
       tp.par048_top_up_ratio,
       tp.par066_negative_top_up_rate,
       tp.par077_severe_top_up_rate,
       tp.par105_days_since_last_top_up,
       tp.top_up_entry_rate,
       v.items_benchmarked, v.par076_low_price_item_rate, v.par076_shortfall_share,
       v.ctx_implausible_price_rate,
       v.origin_benchmark_share, v.price_deviation_median,
       ow.hs_codes_compared, ow.own_price_drop_share,
       du.low_duty_value_share, du.duty_gap_share,
       ap.exemption_apc_value_share, ap.watchlist_apc_value_share, ap.watchlist_apcs_used,
       sp.same_day_split_share, sp.same_day_split_expected, sp.same_day_split_excess, sp.max_same_day_same_hs,
       tp.days_since_first_in_window,
       CASE WHEN pr.tin IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END          AS new_trader,
       tp.ctx_unpaid_rate, tp.ctx_red_lane_rate, tp.ctx_yellow_lane_rate, s.ctx_preferential_use_rate,
       yr.y1_entries, yr.y1_topped_up, yr.y1_severe, yr.y1_amended, yr.y1_tax_reduced, yr.y1_top_up_ugx, yr.y1_original_tax_ugx,
       yr.y2_entries, yr.y2_topped_up, yr.y2_severe, yr.y2_amended, yr.y2_tax_reduced, yr.y2_top_up_ugx, yr.y2_original_tax_ugx,
       yr.y3_entries, yr.y3_topped_up, yr.y3_severe, yr.y3_amended, yr.y3_tax_reduced, yr.y3_top_up_ugx, yr.y3_original_tax_ugx,
       yr.days_since_last_top_up_36m,
       COALESCE(o.out_entries, 0)            AS out_entries,
       COALESCE(o.out_checked, 0)            AS out_checked,
       COALESCE(o.out_checked_hits, 0)       AS out_checked_hits,
       COALESCE(o.out_topped_up_entries, 0)  AS out_topped_up_entries,
       COALESCE(o.out_top_up, 0)             AS out_top_up,
       COALESCE(o.out_original_tax, 0)       AS out_original_tax
FROM tp
LEFT JOIN st          ON st.tin = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN struct s    ON s.tin  = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN dom dm      ON dm.tin = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN v76 v       ON v.tin  = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN outc o      ON o.tin  = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN own_tp ow   ON ow.tin = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN duty_tp du  ON du.tin = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN apc_tp ap   ON ap.tin = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN split_tp sp ON sp.tin = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN prior pr    ON pr.tin = tp.tin
LEFT JOIN yr          ON yr.tin = tp.tin
"""
TRACKB_SQL = """-- =====================================================================================
-- Track B (discovery) features at @@SNAP_DATE@@, one row per taxpayer
-- Reads the cleaned item table ctrp_items (built once per snapshot by the Zeppelin notebook,
-- with the same cleaning rules as the main extract) and the view itself for first-seen dates.
-- History window: items after @@HIST_START@@ up to @@SNAP@@. Recent window: the last 6 months.
-- No input records what customs did (no top-ups, no lanes): Track B measures behaviour only.
-- =====================================================================================
WITH hist AS (
  SELECT * FROM ctrp_items WHERE assessment_dt_wid > '@@HIST_START@@' AND assessment_dt_wid <= '@@SNAP@@'
),

-- What: each taxpayer's first ever IM4 or IM7 declaration up to the snapshot (whole view).
-- Why:  "new" must mean new to customs, not new to the window.
first_seen AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin, MIN(assessment_dt_wid) AS first_dt
  FROM dm_modeled_ura_datascience.vw_cstm_AEO_model
  WHERE assessment_dt_wid <= '@@SNAP@@'
    AND regime_cd IN ('IM4', 'IM7')
    AND decl_status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND taxpayer_tin RLIKE '^[0-9]{10}$'
  GROUP BY taxpayer_tin
),

-- (1, 2) pace: value and declarations per active month, and the last 90 days of value
pace AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin,
         SUM(customs_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT substr(assessment_dt_wid, 1, 6))          AS value_per_active_month,
         COUNT(DISTINCT instance_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT substr(assessment_dt_wid, 1, 6))  AS entries_per_active_month,
         SUM(CASE WHEN adate > date_sub(DATE '@@SNAP_DATE@@', 90) THEN customs_value ELSE 0 END) AS value_last_90d,
         SUM(customs_value)                                                             AS value_hist
  FROM hist
  GROUP BY taxpayer_tin
),

-- (3) duty rate per tariff line: median rate other importers pay with no exemption (APC 000)
line_rate AS (
  SELECT hsc_cd, substr(hsc_cd, 1, 4) AS heading,
         percentile_approx(tax_assessed / customs_value, 0.5) AS med_rate
  FROM hist
  WHERE customs_value > 0 AND tax_assessed >= 0 AND cpc_cd = '000'
  GROUP BY hsc_cd
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT taxpayer_tin) >= 5
),

-- headings whose lines carry different duty: the cheapest line, and how wide the gap is
heading_low AS (
  SELECT heading, MIN(med_rate) AS low_rate, MAX(med_rate) AS high_rate
  FROM line_rate
  GROUP BY heading
  HAVING MAX(med_rate) - MIN(med_rate) >= 0.05
),

items_h AS (
  SELECT i.taxpayer_tin AS tin, h.heading, i.customs_value,
         CASE WHEN r.med_rate <= h.low_rate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS on_low_line
  FROM hist i
  JOIN line_rate r ON i.hsc_cd = r.hsc_cd
  JOIN heading_low h ON r.heading = h.heading
  WHERE i.customs_value > 0 AND i.cpc_cd = '000'
),

-- the share of value all importers put on the cheapest line of each heading
heading_norm AS (
  SELECT heading, SUM(on_low_line * customs_value) / SUM(customs_value) AS norm_low_share
  FROM items_h
  GROUP BY heading
),

low_line AS (
  SELECT i.tin,
         SUM(i.on_low_line * i.customs_value) / SUM(i.customs_value)          AS low_line_share,
         SUM(n.norm_low_share * i.customs_value) / SUM(i.customs_value)       AS low_line_expected,
         SUM(i.on_low_line * i.customs_value) / SUM(i.customs_value)
           - SUM(n.norm_low_share * i.customs_value) / SUM(i.customs_value)   AS low_line_excess,
         SUM(i.customs_value)                                                AS low_line_value_tested
  FROM items_h i
  JOIN heading_norm n ON i.heading = n.heading
  GROUP BY i.tin
),

-- (4) profile drift: recent value in chapters or origins not seen in the 18 months before
early_ch AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT taxpayer_tin AS tin, substr(hsc_cd, 1, 2) AS ch
  FROM hist WHERE adate <= add_months(DATE '@@SNAP_DATE@@', -6)
),
early_or AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT taxpayer_tin AS tin, gds_org_cty AS org
  FROM hist WHERE adate <= add_months(DATE '@@SNAP_DATE@@', -6)
),
recent AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin, substr(hsc_cd, 1, 2) AS ch, gds_org_cty AS org, customs_value
  FROM hist WHERE adate > add_months(DATE '@@SNAP_DATE@@', -6)
),
drift AS (
  SELECT r.tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN c.ch IS NULL THEN r.customs_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(r.customs_value), 0)  AS new_chapter_value_share,
         SUM(CASE WHEN o.org IS NULL THEN r.customs_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(r.customs_value), 0) AS new_origin_value_share,
         COUNT(*)                                                                                       AS recent_items
  FROM recent r
  LEFT JOIN early_ch c ON r.tin = c.tin AND r.ch = c.ch
  LEFT JOIN early_or o ON r.tin = o.tin AND r.org = o.org
  GROUP BY r.tin
),

-- (5) quantity: kilograms per unit against the norm for the tariff line
kgpu_norm AS (
  SELECT hsc_cd, percentile_approx(net_weight / supplementary_qnty, 0.5) AS med_kgpu
  FROM hist
  WHERE net_weight > 0 AND supplementary_qnty > 0
  GROUP BY hsc_cd
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT taxpayer_tin) >= 5
),
qty AS (
  SELECT i.taxpayer_tin AS tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN i.net_weight / i.supplementary_qnty > 3 * n.med_kgpu
                   AND i.net_weight / i.supplementary_qnty <= 100 * n.med_kgpu
                  THEN i.customs_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(i.customs_value), 0) AS heavy_per_unit_value_share,
         COUNT(*)                                                                    AS items_unit_tested
  FROM hist i
  JOIN kgpu_norm n ON i.hsc_cd = n.hsc_cd
  WHERE i.net_weight > 0 AND i.supplementary_qnty > 0
  GROUP BY i.taxpayer_tin
),

-- (6) preference claimed on an origin outside the preference area (list to be confirmed by
-- the Risk Officers: EAC and COMESA partner states, ISO two-letter codes)
pref AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN preferential_treatment_flag = 'Y' AND gds_org_cty NOT IN (@@PREF_ORIGINS@@)
                  THEN customs_value ELSE 0 END)
           / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN preferential_treatment_flag = 'Y' THEN customs_value ELSE 0 END), 0)
                                                                     AS pref_outside_area_share
  FROM hist
  GROUP BY taxpayer_tin
),

-- (7) exemption codes: the longest span, in months, over which one exemption APC kept being used
apc_span AS (
  SELECT taxpayer_tin AS tin, cpc_cd,
         months_between(to_date(MAX(assessment_dt_wid), 'yyyyMMdd'), to_date(MIN(assessment_dt_wid), 'yyyyMMdd')) AS span_months,
         COUNT(DISTINCT substr(assessment_dt_wid, 1, 6))                                                       AS months_used
  FROM hist
  WHERE cpc_cd <> '000'
  GROUP BY taxpayer_tin, cpc_cd
),
apc_tp AS (
  SELECT tin, MAX(span_months) AS exemption_longest_span_months, MAX(months_used) AS exemption_most_months_used
  FROM apc_span
  GROUP BY tin
),

-- (8) revenue at stake: the share of value in tariff lines where peers pay 25% or more
exposure AS (
  SELECT i.taxpayer_tin AS tin,
         SUM(CASE WHEN r.med_rate >= 0.25 THEN i.customs_value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(i.customs_value), 0) AS high_duty_value_share
  FROM hist i
  JOIN line_rate r ON i.hsc_cd = r.hsc_cd
  WHERE i.customs_value > 0
  GROUP BY i.taxpayer_tin
)

SELECT p.tin                                   AS taxpayer_tin,
       '@@SNAP_DATE@@'                         AS snapshot_date,
       f.first_dt                              AS first_declaration_date,
       CASE WHEN f.first_dt > '@@NEW_SINCE@@' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS new_in_last_12m,
       p.value_per_active_month, p.entries_per_active_month, p.value_last_90d, p.value_hist,
       l.low_line_share, l.low_line_expected, l.low_line_excess, l.low_line_value_tested,
       d.new_chapter_value_share, d.new_origin_value_share, d.recent_items,
       q.heavy_per_unit_value_share, q.items_unit_tested,
       pr.pref_outside_area_share,
       a.exemption_longest_span_months, a.exemption_most_months_used,
       e.high_duty_value_share
FROM pace p
LEFT JOIN first_seen f ON f.tin = p.tin
LEFT JOIN low_line l   ON l.tin = p.tin
LEFT JOIN drift d      ON d.tin = p.tin
LEFT JOIN qty q        ON q.tin = p.tin
LEFT JOIN pref pr      ON pr.tin = p.tin
LEFT JOIN apc_tp a     ON a.tin = p.tin
LEFT JOIN exposure e   ON e.tin = p.tin
"""


def month_end(d, months):
    """The last day of the month `months` away from date d (negative = earlier)."""
    y, m = divmod(d.year * 12 + d.month - 1 + months, 12)
    return datetime.date(y, m + 1, calendar.monthrange(y, m + 1)[1])


def ymd(d):
    return d.strftime('%Y%m%d')


def fill(sql, snap, live):
    s = datetime.date.fromisoformat(snap)
    hist_start = month_end(s, -HISTORY_MONTHS)
    out_end = s if live else month_end(s, OUTCOME_MONTHS)
    values = {'@@SNAP_DATE@@': snap, '@@SNAP@@': ymd(s), '@@HIST_START@@': ymd(hist_start),
              '@@HIST3_START@@': ymd(month_end(s, -YEARS_MONTHS)), '@@OUT_END@@': ymd(out_end), '@@PRIOR_START@@': ymd(month_end(hist_start, -PRIOR_MONTHS)),
              '@@NEW_SINCE@@': ymd(month_end(s, -12)),
              '@@PREF_ORIGINS@@': ', '.join("'%s'" % c for c in PREF_ORIGINS)}
    for k, v in values.items():
        sql = sql.replace(k, v)
    return sql


def save(df, name):
    """Keep the result in memory as a table named after the extract (dashes become underscores),
    and only write a CSV folder when SAVE_TO_FOLDER is True."""
    view = name.replace('-', '_')
    df = df.cache()
    df.createOrReplaceTempView(view)
    n = df.count()                                  # computes it once and keeps it
    if SAVE_TO_FOLDER:
        df.coalesce(1).write.mode('overwrite').option('header', True).csv(OUT_DIR + '/' + name)
    return n


def already_done(name):
    """True when this extract was finished earlier: its folder exists (when saving) or its
    table is in this session. Lets paragraph 5 be re-run after a failure without repeating work."""
    if SAVE_TO_FOLDER:
        jpath = spark._jvm.org.apache.hadoop.fs.Path(OUT_DIR + '/' + name + '/_SUCCESS')
        return _fs.exists(jpath)
    return name.replace('-', '_') in [t.name for t in spark.catalog.listTables()]


def run_snapshot(snap, live):
    """Build the cleaned items once, keep them in memory, write the main and Track B extracts."""
    name = ('live_' if live else 'bt_') + snap
    if already_done(name):
        print('%s: already done, skipped' % name)
        return name
    t0 = time.time()
    items = spark.sql(fill(ITEMS_SQL, snap, live))
    items.createOrReplaceTempView('ctrp_items')
    spark.catalog.cacheTable('ctrp_items')
    n_items = spark.table('ctrp_items').count()
    print('%s: %s cleaned items cached (%.1f min)' % (name, format(n_items, ','), (time.time() - t0) / 60))
    n = save(spark.sql(fill(MAIN_SQL, snap, live)), name)
    print('%s: main extract ready, %s taxpayers (%.1f min)' % (name, format(n, ','), (time.time() - t0) / 60))
    if RUN_TRACK_B:
        save(spark.sql(fill(TRACKB_SQL, snap, live)), 'trackb_' + name)
        print('%s: Track B ready (%.1f min)' % (name, (time.time() - t0) / 60))
    spark.catalog.uncacheTable('ctrp_items')
    return name


print('definitions loaded: %d snapshots to run' % len(SNAPSHOTS))
